source.title: Food Shortage
source.description:
<The chef begins speaking before you could manage a simple greeting.>

Thank the light, help finally arrived! Neither the stove nor the pantry can keep up with the sudden surge in orders coming in. Something happened that cut off our usual supply lines, and I assume all the screaming outside has something to do with it.

Whatever the reason, I need assistance. Now. Fetch me whatever looks vaguely edible from around town and we'll go from there.
source.objective: Acquire Unappetizing Leftovers from across New Avalon and return them to the chef. If you are having trouble finding them scattered around, you may have better luck solving this shortage with violence.
source.progress: Please leave me alone until you have gathered some ingredients.
source.completion:
Oh. Oh... I expected day-old bread, overripe fruit, and maybe a plate of half-eaten cookies or something.

I truly have no clue what any of these dishes once were, and I made them! And that... smell... Are you trying to sabotage my kitchen?

Deep breaths, Carrie...
<The chef closes her eyes and inhales slowly through her nostrils, exhaling softly a moment later.>

Let's try this again.
